'''Roger Vidosa Riba'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Vidosa|Riba}} (born February 29, 1984, in [[La Massana]]) was an [[Andorra]]n alpine skier.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.fis-ski.com/DB/general/athlete-biography.html?sector=AL&competitorid=64144 |title=VIDOSA Roger - Athlete Information |website=www.fis-ski.com}}</ref> He represented [[Andorra at the 2006 Winter Olympics]] and at the [[Andorra at the 2010 Winter Olympics|2010 Winter Olympics]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.olympic.org/vancouver-2010 |title=Vancouver 2010 Winter Olympics - results & video highlights |date=June 19, 2019 |website=International Olympic Committee}}</ref><ref name="SR">{{cite Sports-Reference |title=Roger Vidosa |quote=Full name: Roger Vidosa Riba}}</ref>

==After retirement==

Vidosa retired as an Alpine Skier in April 2013. After retirement he became a [[Ski Instructor]] in [[Andorra]] for 5 months and then in [[Leeds]], [[United Kingdom]] for 10 months. He took up the job of a [[Personal Trainer]] in July 2013 at The Gym Group in Leeds, UK for a year.

He studied at [[Paul Sabatier University]] for a year and became Strength and Conditioning Coach at Track League of [[Midi-Pyrenees]], [[Toulouse]] Area, [[France]]  in December 2014 where he works till date.
